Scope: playgrounds at three locations (Qassim Oasis, Hail and Tabuk Industrial City), with civil, architectural, electrical, mechanical and landscape works and general site works, including air domes at Qassim and Tabuk and a toilet building at each site.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours (weekly report, Physical Progress sheet). At 22-Nov-2026 the project is 85.94% complete against 93.00% planned, behind by 7.06% (SPI 0.92). It gained 2.16% this week against 2.53% planned, so the gap widened from 6.69% to 7.06%.

The schedule now finishes the project 89 days after the contract date. The P6 update (data date 20-Nov-2026) and the weekly report both forecast handover on 15-Mar-2027 against the contract completion date of 16-Dec-2026, with −75.9 days of float; last week the forecast was 09-Mar-2027. 175 of the 271 open activities have negative float and 29 activities have failed to start. The air domes are furthest behind: Qassim 39.96% against 95.58% planned and Tabuk 35.13% against 90.68%, with no progress for the sixth week running.

Data notes

  • Progress figures are the weekly report's physical progress (effort), weighted by 33,340 budgeted man-hours. 10,000 of them (30%) sit on the time-based “Project Durations” activities (management line), which earn progress as time passes and stand at 91.15% (9,115 man-hours; in P6, 4,100 complete and 5,900 at 85%). Without them the project would be 83.71% complete against 93.76% planned, behind by 10.05% rather than 7.06%. The two air domes carry only 1,116 man-hours each (6.7% of all man-hours) although they are 23.4% of the contract value, so their stoppage hardly moves the physical %. By comparison, the invoiced value to date is 4,244,771 SAR (11.9% of the contract value) and the FIR value to date 4,464,608 SAR (12.5%). The report still shows the contractor's physical % as given. The report's dashboard, and the new “Weekly Progress Report” presentation uploaded this week, show cost-based progress labelled as actual; this report uses physical progress only.
  • The report states “Current Contract Weeks: 0 of 0”, so the week number is counted from site handover (17-Feb-2026): 278 days, week 39.
  • The “Weekly Physical Progress” columns hold 84.36% planned and 75.02% earned, which match neither week's to-date figures. Progress this week is taken as the change in to-date progress since the 15-Nov-2026 report.
  • All major quantities are identical in the six reports from 18-Oct to 22-Nov-2026, although tartan, kerbstone, stamped concrete and irrigation work was reported; the sheet appears not to have been updated.
  • Man-hours by site: Tabuk toilet building still shows 0 of 1,708 man-hours earned with only 40 planned, and Tabuk closeout has no budget but 127.6 man-hours earned. Each of the three sites shows exactly 127.6 closeout man-hours earned (114 each last week).
  • The milestone sheet still gives complete mobilisation as 14-Apr-2026 against 18-Mar-2026 with 0 days change. The Testing sheet gives the end of construction at Hail as 09-Dec-2026, while P6 gives 24-Dec-2026.
  • Procurement: the summary has 8 of 57 materials on site, unchanged for five weeks, while the P6 delivery activities are 80–95% complete and four of them closed this week. The procurement log has no delivered quantities or dates.
  • Invoices: the summary shows 0 submitted invoices while the log lists IPC-01 to IPC-03. Paid invoices (4,348,338 SAR) exceed the gross submitted value although none is PM-approved. The FIR summary total rose again, to 4,464,608, now 219,837 above the gross invoiced value: this week's increase of 111,520 is a 100,000 line with no FIR reference and a second copy of the FIR-0682 row (11,520). The earlier duplicates (FIR-0529, FIR-0550, FIR-0630) and the 60,000 line without a reference remain. The dashboard's penalties of −469,477 combine advance payment recovery and deductions.
  • Manpower: the dashboard shows 46 manual workers while the Manpower sheet has 65 for November, and the Manpower sheet is again unchanged. The DB sheet still holds another project's data (HAL1-02-005).
  • Quality: the Quality-Stat sheet now shows the 14 irrigation shop drawings as pending with none approved (9 approved last week), and its total of 499 shop drawings differs from the 485 on the dashboard.
  • The P6 update has a data date of 20-Nov-2026, against 22-Nov-2026 for the weekly report. The new “Weekly Progress Report” presentation shows 271 of 302 days elapsed, last week's figure (278 days at 22-Nov-2026). Three PDFs are still named MLTX-05-047 although they belong to MLTX-02-003.
  • The contractor forecast in the Physical-Chart Data sheet starts at 0 in February, 365 man-hours below the actual, so it stays slightly below actual until October.
